title: Event-conditioned signed social direction
claim: During causally observed social-attention shocks, lagged polarity surprise or disagreement change improves one-hour or four-hour signed return forecasts over market-only, signed-social-only, and attention-state-only baselines; outside those events the strategy abstains.
mechanism: Attention shocks identify discrete information arrival while polarity surprise or disagreement change supplies sign. Slow and fragmented public-information diffusion may leave conditional directional information after market controls even though unconditional social direction failed.
target: One-hour and four-hour outright log returns for the registered ten-asset Binance USDT perpetual universe, with acted-on and abstained observations reported separately.
horizon: 1h and 4h from an hourly UTC decision clock.
informationSet: Receipt-causal attention shock available at the decision timestamp
Lagged polarity surprise or disagreement change computed without future messages or revisions
Frozen point-in-time market controls and historical asset eligibility
primaryBaseline: The strongest zero, historical-mean, market-only, signed-social-only, or attention-state-only point-in-time baseline.

evidence.summary: A materially distinct conditional signed-social mechanism is registered after unconditional direction and variance-based exposure mappings failed. No target outcome or historical period was opened by registration.
Manifest-only audit found no untouched materialized historical social period: all feature manifests end by 2026-08-01 and overlap opened or unknown-boundary outcomes. No target-bearing row was read.

The registered eight-variant family stopped before model fitting because disagreement-change supplied only 87 acted rows in chronological fold one versus the frozen minimum of 100. Polarity surprise passed coverage, but it may not be promoted as a post-outcome subgroup.

nextAction: Preserve this DATA_BLOCKED family and consumed discovery period. A successor may preregister a materially distinct polarity-shock-only candidate before fitting, or identify a larger already-existing signed archive; do not lower the coverage gate or silently drop disagreement.

searchBudget.attentionGate: one training-only quantile frozen before evaluation
